sections.heading: Type power
lines: Dark moves and ice moves are 1.5× stronger.
Ghost moves are 1.3× stronger.
Bitter Blade, Bitter Malice, Dark Pulse, Hydro Pump, Muddy Water, Night Slash, Surf, and Water Pulse also count as Ice for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Bitter Blade, Bitter Malice, Black Hole Eclipse, Fiery Wrath, Freezing Glare, Lash Out, Outrage, Rage, Raging Fury, Roar of Time, Stomping Tantrum, and Thrash: 1.5× stronger.
Dark Pulse, Hydro Pump, Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Muddy Water, Night Slash, Surf, and Water Pulse: 1.2× stronger.
Court Change, Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Gravity, Magic Room, Misty Terrain, Psychic Terrain, Teatime, Trick Room, and Wonder Room: no effect here.
Dark Void: 100% accuracy.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Ice-type.
Nature Power becomes Ice Beam.
Secret Power can cause freezing.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Burning Jealousy, Eruption, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Inferno Overdrive, Lava Plume, Mind Blown, Raging Fury, and Searing Shot change the field into Dimensional once their uses add up to 2 (Burning Jealousy 1, Eruption 2, Fire Pledge 1, Flame Burst 1, Heat Wave 1, Incinerate 1, Inferno Overdrive 2, Lava Plume 2, Mind Blown 1, Raging Fury 1, and Searing Shot 1).
Purify changes the field into Icy.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Anger Point or Justified: Attack +1 when it enters.
Anger Shell: Attack +1, Special Attack +1, Speed +1, Defense −1, and Special Defense −1 when it enters.
Berserk: Special Attack +1 when it enters.
Rattled: Speed +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Ice Body restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Weather and status
lines: Snow becomes Hail.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Speed +2 and gains a special effect.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
